label: D2 update gate high when belief favours S2 and a2 chosen, grows late in episode
terms: (phase == D2) * np.tanh(belief_lo/2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * np.tanh(belief_lo/2) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * np.tanh(belief_lo/2) * ep_dec**2 ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_action == 2) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * ep_dec**2
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 7. Near zero at D1, small at GO, large at D2 (timing alone R^2 0.72, rising strongly over the episode). Beyond timing, magnitude is set mainly at D2 by the ideal-observer belief: high when the observed history favours S2 being good (belief_lo negative), low when it favours S1, with the effect growing later in the episode (belief x ep_dec). It is also higher at D2 when this trial chose a2 (observed at D2) and reached S2, and when the previous choice was a2. At GO a smaller version of the same belief signal appears, amplified late in the episode, plus a boost after an unrewarded a2 trial late in the episode. Belief plus choice/state alone gives about 0.69 dev; the full 7 observed-only terms give 0.74 dev / 0.72 test R^2 beyond timing (all-observed ceiling 0.82, all 0.88; model-policy decile alone 0.76, so replacing the model policy with observed belief loses little). Residual misses: late-episode GO/D2 after a2 S1 r/u under-predicted, D2 after a1 unrewarded over-predicted. Reward of this trial (future) explains nothing.

issues: The claim that the D2 gate is higher when the previous choice was a2 is not supported. That term's fitted weight is -0.00016, so it is about zero and has the opposite sign to the claim. Dropping it leaves test R^2 unchanged (0.7209 with it, 0.7209 without it). Adding it alone to the base terms gives only +0.002 (0.672 to 0.674).

A large systematic error class is left over and is mentioned only in passing. In the misses output for the claimed terms, D2 after a2-S1-rewarded trials is under-predicted by +0.101. D2 after a1-S1-unrewarded trials is over-predicted by -0.105, and after a1-S2-unrewarded trials by -0.098. The explanation names only the 'a2-S1 late' and 'unrewarded a1' cases. It does not say that the previous trial's outcome shapes the D2 gate as a main effect, separately from belief.

The previous-trial effect at D2 is large and should be in the label. A D2 term for 'previous a1 unrewarded' gets weight -0.113 and a D2 term for 'previous a2-S1-rewarded' gets weight +0.091, comparable to the belief weight (about -0.075 to -0.116). Adding them moves test R^2 from 0.72 to 0.78.

The 'grows late in the episode' interaction for belief at D2 is real but modest: it adds +0.013 on test (0.672 to 0.685). The two GO terms together add about +0.036. These parts of the claim check out.

The core claims check out. Belief at D2 alone gives 0.647 on test. Belief plus this trial's choice and state gives 0.672. The signs are as stated: a2 and S2 raise the gate, and belief favouring S1 lowers it.
